intro: A Net Disaster is an Elwynn Forest quest centered on an unusual disruption at Crystal Lake. With hook-and-line fishing yielding nothing and even minnows disappearing from the shallows, adventurers are dispatched to check overnight traps. The ruined traps reveal that hostile neighboring intruders are actively wrecking local fishing gear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.
Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
